function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Cream‑colored clothing can look great if you pair it thoughtfully! Here’s how:

| What you’re doing | Why it works |
|-------------------|--------------|
| **Add contrast** – Pair cream tops with darker bottoms (navy pants, charcoal skirts) so your outfit doesn’t blend into one color block. | Keeps the look balanced and prevents “washed out” vibes. |
| **Layer smartly** – Use denim jackets, leather vests, or tweed blazers over cream pieces. | Adds depth and texture while keeping the neutral base subtle. |
| **Accessorize boldly** – Think bright scarves, patterned belts, or metallic jewelry. | Breaks up the neutrality and gives personality to the ensemble. |
| **Mix neutrals wisely** – Combine cream with ivory, taupe, or soft pastels for an airy feel. | Works well for spring/summer events or relaxed office settings. |
| **Consider occasion & lighting** – Cream looks crisp under natural light but may appear muted indoors without good lighting. | Helps avoid looking washed out during photoshoots or indoor meetings. |

If you want specific product suggestions—like shirts, trousers, or accessories—to match those ideas, just let me know what type of item you're after and I'll pull some options from our catalog.
message.reasoning: The user asks about wearing cream-colored clothes; this is not a request for product info but general advice. We can respond with style tips. No tool needed.
